hinaus.et: From Middle High German hinūz, from Old High German hinaūz. By surface analysis, hin + aus.

s: up; upward; upwards (from the own location upwards, in direction away from the speaker)
hinauf.et: From Middle High German hinūf, from Old High German hinūf, hinaūf. By surface analysis, hin + auf.

s: up; upward; upwards (from the own location upwards)
Wir müssen diesen Berg hinan, und das braucht seine Zeit.

hinaus-.et: Compound of the prefixes hin- + aus-, or rather simply hinaus in compounds.
